hunks.baseline: A sharpened dagger dug into a Hobgoblin corpse.
hunks.sol: A razor-sharp dagger dug into a Hobgoblin corpse.

hunks.baseline: Fluids splattered, and a foul stench filled the air, but I didn’t stop. I discarded the heads, neatly cut away the hides from their backs and bellies, and stacked them in a pile.
hunks.sol: Fluids splattered and a foul stench filled the air, but I didn’t stop. I discarded the heads, neatly cut the hides from their backs and bellies, and stacked them in a pile.

hunks.baseline: It was Team Leader Choi. His kindly voice made me feel guilty. Getting jealous of someone like him—how childish was that?
hunks.sol: It was Team Leader Choi. The kindness in his voice made me feel guilty. Getting jealous of someone like him—how childish was that?

hunks.baseline: *It’s not like I’m going through puberty.*
hunks.sol: *What am I, a teenager?*

hunks.baseline: A little over ten minutes, so about twenty seconds per corpse? Even Im Kkeokjeong sidled over, drawn by the speed, and his mouth fell open.
hunks.sol: A little over ten minutes, so about twenty seconds per corpse? Im Kkeokjeong came over to watch and gaped at how fast I was.

hunks.baseline: “Damn, have you been doing nothing but this?”
hunks.sol: “Damn, do you do nothing but this all day?”

hunks.baseline: “Plenty, my ass. You’re a total professional.”
hunks.sol: “Plenty, my ass. You’re a full-blown professional.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m just fast with my hands.”
hunks.sol: “I’m just quick with my hands.”

hunks.baseline: I’d done factory part-time jobs in school. I’d even stuck eyes on dolls. In a way, I’d started this before I ever worked as a Hunter.
hunks.sol: I’d worked factory jobs back in school. I’d even stuck eyes on dolls. In a way, I’d started doing this before I ever worked as a Hunter.

hunks.baseline: “I kept doing it during raids, too.”
hunks.sol: “I kept it up during raids, too.”

hunks.baseline: “No. I just did both. A side job.”
hunks.sol: “No. I did both. It was a side job.”

hunks.baseline: “Exactly what kind?”
hunks.sol: “What exactly did you do?”

hunks.baseline: “I just split the rest time after combat to do the work.”
hunks.sol: “I carved out time during breaks after combat and did this.”

hunks.baseline: “Do you receive additional pay?”
hunks.sol: “Did you receive additional pay?”

hunks.baseline: “Of course. It’s work, too.”
hunks.sol: “Of course. It’s work too.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ve kept at it. From the beginning until now.”
hunks.sol: “The whole time. From the beginning until now.”

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong was floored.
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong shook his head in disbelief.

hunks.baseline: “You hardcore bastard. I couldn’t do that.”
hunks.sol: “You relentless bastard. I couldn’t do that.”

hunks.baseline: “Your life’s on the line, and you’re building stamina? Hahaha. Team Leader Choi, didn’t I tell you? There’s nobody who works as relentlessly as this kid.”
hunks.sol: “Your life’s on the line, and you’re using it to build stamina? Hahaha! Team Leader Choi, didn’t I tell you? Nobody works as hard as this kid.”

hunks.baseline: *Did you say that?*
hunks.sol: *You told him that?*

hunks.baseline: “Keep working hard.”
hunks.sol: “Keep it up.”

hunks.baseline: *No, what?*
hunks.sol: *No, seriously, what?*

hunks.baseline: The raid went smoothly. The E-rank Hunters had been in sync so long they moved as one. Once they cut the monsters’ numbers down, Team Leader Choi took over.
hunks.sol: The raid went smoothly. The E-rank Hunters had worked together for so long that they moved as one. Once they thinned out the monsters, Team Leader Choi took over.

hunks.baseline: I’d seen real martial arts with my own eyes—and even learned them. Not the dance-like moves I practiced in the city park at dawn.
hunks.sol: Not the dance-like routines people practiced in city parks at dawn, but real martial arts. I’d seen them with my own eyes and even learned them myself.

hunks.baseline: It was ridiculous. There was no way it would work, but I was going to try once.
hunks.sol: It was ridiculous. There was no way it would work, but I could at least try once.

hunks.baseline: That was the moment I was about to take a careful step.
hunks.sol: Just as I was about to take a cautious step—

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi’s voice snapped me straight back.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi’s voice snapped me back to my senses.
*I’ve completely lost it.*

hunks.baseline: *I’ve completely lost it.* Getting distracted in the middle of a raid.
hunks.sol: I’d gotten distracted in the middle of a raid.

hunks.baseline: That was courtesy to my teammates—and the conviction that would keep me alive.
hunks.sol: That was only fair to my teammates—and it was the principle that would keep me alive.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. I’m coming!”
hunks.sol: “Yes. Coming!”

hunks.baseline: I ran over like the wind and started taking the corpses apart.
hunks.sol: I raced over like the wind and started taking the corpses apart.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi and Im Kkeokjeong loitered nearby the whole rest period, like they weren’t tired at all.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi and Im Kkeokjeong hovered nearby throughout the break as if they weren’t tired at all.

hunks.baseline: *It’s seriously getting on my nerves.*
hunks.sol: *They’re seriously getting on my nerves.*

hunks.baseline: “Wow. At that point, you’re pretty much a master. A real master.”
hunks.sol: “Wow. At that point, you’re practically a master. A real master.”

hunks.baseline: The break after that, too.
hunks.sol: Then again at the break after that.

hunks.baseline: “You’re impressive too, hyung. But I have some work to do.”
hunks.sol: “You’re impressive too, hyung. But I need to get back to work.”

hunks.baseline: “Hyung. I think my cochlea’s been torn open.”
hunks.sol: “Hyung. I think my cochlea’s ruptured.”

hunks.baseline: I wanted to switch to a mage right then and there, just so I could put a silence spell on that man’s mouth.
hunks.sol: I wanted to switch to a mage right then and there, just so I could cast a silence spell on that man’s mouth.

hunks.baseline: There was only one way out. Finish the work before blood really started pouring from my ears. I clenched my teeth and kept my hands moving.
hunks.sol: There was only one way out: finish the work before blood really started pouring from my ears. I clenched my teeth and kept my hands moving.

hunks.baseline: I stood up with the bag on my back, heavier than before. Hobgoblins were generous monsters. Poison-resistant hides, a few usable weapons—and they even dropped two E-grade Magic Gems.
hunks.sol: I stood with the bag on my back, heavier than before. Hobgoblins were the monsters that kept on giving. Poison-resistant hides, a few usable weapons—and they’d even dropped two E-grade Magic Gems.

hunks.baseline: *The hides are in good condition, and there are two Magic Gems. This could be worth a decent amount.*
hunks.sol: *The hides are in good condition, and there are two Magic Gems. This haul should be worth a decent amount.*

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi had contributed the most, so he’d probably take about half. But with so few people, it was still a profitable deal for the other team members.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi had contributed the most, so he’d probably take about half. But with so few people, the other team members would still turn a profit.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi was a fairly generous employer. He was a C-rank Hunter way out of my league, yet he always treated me with respect. His personality was a little unusual, but in this line of work, that made him a decent human being.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi was a fairly generous employer. He was a C-rank Hunter far above me, yet he always spoke politely to me. His personality was a little unusual, but by the standards of this industry, he was practically a saint.

hunks.baseline: *And a skilled Hunter I can trust.*
hunks.sol: *And he’s a skilled Hunter I can trust.*

hunks.baseline: Thanks to him, we’d made it this far at a steady, rapid pace.
hunks.sol: Thanks to him, we’d made it this far quickly and without any trouble.

hunks.baseline: All that remained was the last stretch of the Gate.
hunks.sol: All that remained was the final part of the Gate.

hunks.baseline: If we opened the stone gate in front of us, the Gate’s boss monster and the mana field that would send us outside should be waiting beyond it.
hunks.sol: If we opened the stone gate in front of us, the Gate’s boss monster and the magic field that would send us back outside should be waiting beyond it.

hunks.baseline: “Let’s finish this quick and go out for some gukbap.[^1] Taekyung, you’re coming too, right? And you too, Team Leader Choi.”
hunks.sol: “Let’s finish this quick and grab some gukbap.[^1] Taekyung, you’re coming too, right? You too, Team Leader Choi.”

hunks.baseline: Talking about food with the Boss Zone right in front of us. And on top of that, there was a guy planning to order sushi by himself.
hunks.sol: Talking about food with the Boss Zone right in front of us. And one guy was even planning to order sushi by himself.

hunks.baseline: Of course, I had no right to say that. Just portering and butchering in between had already earned me a day’s pay.
hunks.sol: Of course, I had no right to say that. Just portering and butchering between fights had already earned me a day’s pay.

hunks.baseline: Until I landed a job at a new Guild, if Team Leader Choi kept calling me, I wouldn’t have anything left to wish for. A sweet gig like this? I could do it a hundred times over.
hunks.sol: Until I landed a job at a new Guild, I couldn’t ask for anything more than Team Leader Choi calling me regularly. A cushy gig like this? I could do it a hundred times over.

hunks.baseline: The gate blew apart, and stone dust and dirt poured down. I followed the others into the Boss Zone.
hunks.sol: The gate exploded, showering the ground with powdered stone and dust. I followed the others into the Boss Zone.

hunks.baseline: It was there.
hunks.sol: It stood.

hunks.baseline: An old Hobgoblin in robes marked with unreadable patterns. A withered staff in one hand, a sharp dagger in the other.
hunks.sol: An old Hobgoblin in robes covered with unreadable patterns. A withered staff in one hand, a sharp dagger in the other.

hunks.baseline: Despite the loud crash when the stone gate broke, it went on muttering, unfazed. Each time a syllable ended, black energy rose from the corpses scattered around it.
hunks.sol: Despite the deafening crash of the stone gate breaking, it kept muttering, completely unfazed. Each time it finished a syllable, black energy rose from the corpses scattered around it.

hunks.baseline: I’d seen it right. Nearly a hundred Hobgoblins lay dead on the altar. Looking closer, they were the ones we were supposed to fight in the Boss Zone.
hunks.sol: I’d seen it right. Nearly a hundred dead Hobgoblins lay atop the altar. Looking closer, they were the monsters we should have been fighting in the Boss Zone.

hunks.baseline: *What the hell is this?*
hunks.sol: *What the hell is going on?*

hunks.baseline: While all of us froze at a situation none of us had ever seen, Team Leader Choi shouted like a thunderclap.
hunks.sol: While all of us froze at the unprecedented sight, Team Leader Choi shouted like a thunderclap.

hunks.baseline: That was when the unknown old Hobgoblin turned its head.
hunks.sol: That was when the mysterious old Hobgoblin turned its head.

hunks.baseline: Magic was taking form.
hunks.sol: The spell activated.

hunks.baseline: The tanks hurriedly raised their tower shields. But that was the wrong call. What it had used wasn’t an attack spell.
hunks.sol: The tanks hurriedly raised their tower shields. But that was the wrong call. What it had cast wasn’t an attack spell.

hunks.baseline: “It’s behind us! The passage is being blocked!”
hunks.sol: “Behind us! The passage is being blocked!”

hunks.baseline: As if the clock had been turned back, the shattered stone gate stood intact again.
hunks.sol: As if time had been reversed, the shattered stone gate stood intact again.

hunks.baseline: The rubble on the floor had stacked into double and triple walls, and vines from the cave walls bound them tight.
hunks.sol: The rubble on the ground stacked itself into two, then three layers of walls, and vines from the cave walls wound tightly around them.

hunks.baseline: It was Im Kkeokjeong. His muscles had swollen like they were about to burst—probably a Strength Enhancement Skill. Tower shield in hand, he charged the stone gate.
hunks.sol: It was Im Kkeokjeong. His muscles had swollen as if they were about to burst—he must have used a Strength Enhancement Skill. Tower shield in hand, he charged the stone gate.

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong dropped the tower shield, his face blank with disbelief. An E-rank Hunter had even used a Skill, and he hadn’t broken through. He’d only wrecked his shield.
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong dropped his tower shield, his face blank with disbelief. An E-rank Hunter had used a Skill and still hadn’t broken through. All he’d managed to do was wreck his shield.

hunks.baseline: That old Hobgoblin, using magic like this, was a monster at least one or two stages above us.
hunks.sol: That old Hobgoblin could wield magic powerful enough to make it a monster at least one or two stages above us.

hunks.baseline: There was someone among us who could face it.
hunks.sol: There was someone among us capable of facing it.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi was already charging the thing, as if he’d been sure the passage wouldn’t break.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi was already charging the creature, as if he’d known we wouldn’t be able to break through the blocked passage.

hunks.baseline: His body slid forward. More than a hundred meters vanished in an instant. With five paces left, the sword came free from Team Leader Choi’s waist.
hunks.sol: He shot forward. More than a hundred meters vanished in an instant. With only five paces left, Team Leader Choi drew the sword at his waist.

hunks.baseline: A C-rank Hunter’s full-power attack.
hunks.sol: A full-power attack from a C-rank Hunter.

hunks.baseline: The old Hobgoblin only smirked.
hunks.sol: But the old Hobgoblin merely gave him a nasty grin.

hunks.baseline: The hundred-odd corpses scattered across the altar shriveled, then dispersed like sand. The black energy, fully pulled out of them, gathered into one mass and smashed into Team Leader Choi’s side.
hunks.sol: The hundred-odd corpses scattered across the altar shriveled, then crumbled like sand. The black energy drawn from them gathered into a single mass and slammed into Team Leader Choi’s side.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi bounced back fast. With a twisted face, he said,
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi went flying. His face contorted as he said,

hunks.baseline: Only a few seconds ago, it had been nothing more than energy given form. Now it was rapidly taking shape.
hunks.sol: Only a few seconds ago, it had been nothing more than a tangible mass of energy. Now it was rapidly taking shape.

hunks.baseline: A hulking frame nearly three meters tall. A monster with muscles ready to burst, holding a greatsword of terrifying size.
hunks.sol: A hulking body nearly three meters tall. Bulging muscles and a monstrously huge greatsword.

hunks.baseline: Someone muttered in a dazed voice. Just like me, this had to be the first time they were seeing anything like it.
hunks.sol: Someone muttered in a daze. Like me, they had clearly never seen anything like it before.

hunks.baseline: Only Team Leader Choi knew what they were.
hunks.sol: Only Team Leader Choi knew what the monsters were.

hunks.baseline: “Hobgoblin Great Warrior. A C-rank Rare Monster.”
hunks.sol: “A Hobgoblin Great Warrior. A C-rank Rare Monster.”

hunks.baseline: The fact that something that size was a Hobgoblin was shocking enough. Next to what came after, it was nothing.
hunks.sol: The fact that something that size was a Hobgoblin was shocking enough, but it was nothing compared to what came next.

hunks.baseline: *C-rank Rare Monster?*
hunks.sol: *A C-rank Rare Monster?*

hunks.baseline: Rare Monsters were rare monsters that appeared in a given Gate only at a low rate. And that Great Warrior was C-rank—something the rest of us would never have run into in our lives.
hunks.sol: A Rare Monster was a special creature with only a slim chance of appearing in a given Gate. And that Great Warrior was C-rank—something neither I nor the other team members should ever have encountered in our lives.

hunks.baseline: …Of course, not anymore.
hunks.sol: …Of course, that was no longer true.

hunks.baseline: “Hobgoblin Priest. Also a C-rank Rare Monster.”
hunks.sol: “A Hobgoblin Priest. Also a C-rank Rare Monster.”

hunks.baseline: The curse slipped out before I could stop it. Im Kkeokjeong asked with a stiff face,
hunks.sol: The curse slipped out before I could stop it. Im Kkeokjeong asked with a grim expression,

hunks.baseline: “If we take out the Priest first, there’s hope. In exchange…”
hunks.sol: “If we take out the Priest first, there’s hope. But…”

hunks.baseline: “We need to hold that thing down for a little while.”
hunks.sol: “We need to hold that thing off for a little while.”

hunks.baseline: *Who?*
hunks.sol: *Who does?*

hunks.baseline: The Great Warrior’s roar sent a stalactite dropping from the cave ceiling.
hunks.sol: The Great Warrior’s roar sent a stalactite crashing down from the cave ceiling.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi turned with a resolute look I’d never seen on him before.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi turned away with a resolute look I’d never seen on him before.
